item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Fragile Cease-Fire Takes Hold as Both Sides Claim Victory
item.summary: International relief was tempered by uncertainty over what comes next. Israel declared its support for the two-week truce between the U.S. and Iran, but pressed ahead with its strikes against Hezbollah in Lebanon.

item.title: Even as They Praise Iran Cease-Fire, World Leaders Are Whipsawed by Trump
item.summary: Across Europe and the globe, the war has damaged economies, roiled politics and underscored a lack of options in dealing with President Trump’s whims.

item.title: China Pressed Iran Toward Cease-fire, Iranian Officials Say
item.summary: Beijing appeared to have helped push Tehran to accept the two-week deal with the United States, reflecting China’s growing influence and its stake in avoiding a wider war.

item.title: Ukraine Ramps Up Attacks on Russian Oil, Aiming to Curb Iran War Windfall
item.summary: As the Persian Gulf conflict boosts the oil revenue that finances Moscow’s war against Ukraine, Kyiv’s forces are striking at Russia’s ability to refine and ship its crude.

item.title: Australia Charges Ex-Soldier With War Crimes in Afghanistan
item.summary: The suspect, charged with five counts of murder, is accused of killing or ordering the killings of unarmed civilians during the Afghan war.

item.title: What Trump Has Accomplished in Iran After 5 Weeks of War
item.summary: President Trump said “we have already met and exceeded” his military objectives. But his goals are largely unresolved.

item.title: Hegseth Demands Iran Turn Over Uranium Stockpiles
item.summary: The American defense secretary warned President Trump could still order a commando raid to seize 970 pounds of enriched uranium buried in Isfahan if Iran does not agree.

item.title: Shelly Kittleson, American Journalist Abducted in Iraq, Is Freed
item.summary: The journalist, Shelly Kittleson, was abducted by a militia allied with Iran and held for a week. Iraqi officials say she was freed in exchange for the release of militia members.

item.title: What to Know About the U.S.-Iran Cease-Fire
item.summary: The agreement to pause the fighting for two weeks came hours after President Trump threatened to destroy Iran’s “whole civilization.” Much remains uncertain.

item.title: Pakistan Says It Hit a Military Target. Investigations Suggest It Was a Rehab Center.
item.summary: After the deadliest attack in Afghanistan since the Taliban took over, families searched among photos and remains for signs of their relatives.
